design_components.subject: Jabba the Hutt tattoo
design_components.direction: Preserve Jabba exactly as selected in #101; latest #146 tattoo/grill endorsement continues that baseline. Keep his placement and visibility while extending the bird tail. Do not interpret the earlier transcription jaw as a jaw-shape instruction.

design_components.subject: Millennium Falcon spacecraft
design_components.direction: Use #107 proportions, position and size as the locked standard. Artwork may iterate while respecting that geometry. #101 chest proportions were explicitly excluded. #107 supersedes the previous #91 placement anchor.

design_components.subject: falcon bird, distinct from chest ship
design_components.direction: Bird starts prominently on the face and tail feathers extend down the neck as in #103, without covering or moving Jabba from #101. Latest user approves #146 tattoos generally; Grok reports its tail still stops on the cheek. Preserve this unresolved difference for original-image comparison; do not claim the full tail goal is met.

design_components.subject: optional bird cage tattoo
design_components.direction: If the cage is retained, use #105 as favorite: shift slightly back near the ear so the hanging cage reads like a dangling earring tattoo. Not selected as mandatory and distinct from physical ear jewelry.

design_components.subject: Captain Falcon racer imagery and Captain / Falcon tattoo words
design_components.direction: Remove the racer/character and the words Captain and Falcon from the tattoo design. The falcon bird and Millennium Falcon spacecraft stay. This is a visual-design change, not an instruction to edit supplied song lyrics.

design_components.subject: Chewie and I know
design_components.direction: Keep the smaller achieved font size and same general facial locations. User is content with the sizing and allows later small placement tweaks or swapping. Do not reimpose earlier oversized or rigid numerical placement instructions. Exact sides/coordinates await numbered originals and an annotated map.

design_components.subject: grillz
design_components.direction: Preserve #101 grill design, continued in latest user-endorsed #146. This replaces further general fang/grill exploration as the current baseline. Exact tooth layout and material must be checked against numbered originals; unnumbered Photo5 visually shows an upper gold/bright-stone mix and a separate bright lower row but cannot be assigned to an experiment.

design_components.subject: ear and nose piercings; optional lip ring
design_components.direction: Preserve piercing locations from #147/#149 with small variations in jewelry type. Desired ensemble includes a conventional rapper earring in one ear, dangling jewelry in the other, and a nose piercing. Lip ring remains exploratory. Exact ear/nose sides cannot be resolved from the supplied textual references; do not invent coordinates. Keep #146 tattoos/grill undisturbed.

design_components.subject: neck chains
design_components.direction: Use #57 chain design as an influence; user suggested perhaps two chains. Inspect overlap with chest tattoo and collar. Neither exact count nor final jewelry is locked.

design_components.subject: optional performance prop
design_components.direction: When included, user prefers a thicker blunt silhouette over a thin cigarette. Reserve unobstructed-mouth takes for any rap-sync proof. Prop is not required in every shot.

design_components.subject: Millennium Falcon spacecraft, distinct from the falcon bird
design_components.direction: Start from #91 round ship body with twin forward prongs aimed up the neck. Raise the design so a small slice of the main body remains above a typical shirt collar. User suggested about 13-17 percent of the upper body visible; this is a visual proportion to assess, not a measured pixel mask. Keep the ship recognizable, avoid rocket-like substitution.

design_components.subject: falcon bird
design_components.direction: Use #93 jawline bird as placement starting point. Explore a perch and nearby Captain wording; optional birdcage/perch lettering variants. Do not conflate with the chest spacecraft.

design_components.subject: Optional video-game Captain Falcon neck tattoo / lyric callback
design_components.direction: User wants an additional Captain Falcon callback lower on the same neck side, exploring placements. Grok offered an original substitute; that reply is not an accepted CFA substitution. Motif, scale and placement remain unresolved.

design_components.subject: Chewie and I know
design_components.direction: Reduce lettering substantially: user compared size 42 with 24 (about 57 percent linear size, not actual font units). I know should angle about 45 degrees rather than sit like a central forehead stamp. Earlier Chewie direction was above the character-left eye and diagonal. Fix left/right on an annotated face map before acceptance; screenshots show swapped sides.

design_components.subject: upper canines/jeweled grill and lower grill
design_components.direction: Earlier user preferred small upper gold fangs and a conventional lower grill. Latest feedback asks for more prominent upper canines as part of the upper jeweled grill, matching a supplied close-up. This supersedes treating two isolated tiny fangs as final. Lower grill remains separate; exact material, fang length and tooth coverage await review.
